description: Synthetic football-data.org v4-shaped responses (SC-04: invented data, nothing copied from real responses). Each file: request (method, path, query), status, the documented headers (X-API-Version, X-Authenticated-Client, X-RequestCounter-Reset, X-RequestsAvailable) and either body (a JSON value, served as its JSON text) or bodyText (raw text). The X-Authenticated-Client value is the synthetic marker edr-test-client-marker-0000 (T11H-F04). Person data (referees, coaches) uses values starting with edr-person-marker-; crests use the reserved .invalid domain.
